purpose: Execution and evidence matrix only; this file never changes TODO status.

pre-0.24.2.prohibition: Do not synthesize, flag-edit, or relabel a later save as this fixture.

global_invariants: Obtain explicit user permission before starting EU4, dowser, or Paradox Launcher.
Use ordinary copied snapshots under the EU4 user mod directory; never junctions or repository paths.
Use a dedicated isolated playset containing exactly the descriptors declared for the session.
Exclude Graphical Map Improvements, the Chinese localisation mod, and every unrelated mod.
Use main-only for existing saves and 0.27 fixture generation; companion map always requires a new campaign.
Create a before-session record, then collect fresh logs, named JXP_ACC_ saves, and screenshots after exit.
Debug scaffolds accelerate setup but never substitute for natural triggers, formal mission rewards, UI clicks, save serialization, or engine rendering.

Advance one day and then a second day to allow startup migration and two-phase mission refresh.

Old power structures and permanent political capstone modifiers clear across transitions.

scenarios.title: CJP harmonization and native center behavior
scenarios.playset: current main + map for new campaign; current main-only for a genuine 0.27 CJP save
scenarios.fixture: new disposable CJP route campaign plus the real 0.27 CJP input from R4
steps: Run the current-map-new phase, enter CJP, and allow the normal Confucian setup event to create native centers without directly placing centers or harmonization flags.
Record harmony, setup flags, and native-center count before and after a second route reconcile; Shinto must harmonize once and no fourth center may appear.

After normal CJP setup creates its native centers, run JXP_ACC_R6_protected_targets.txt and protect four separate Shinto targets before natural spread: Ise 4359, one religious_center province, one religious_zeal_at_conv province, and one existing reformation center; prove each remains ineligible. If province 1028 loses its existing center when changed to Shinto, stop the branch rather than placing a replacement.

Observe at least one natural engine conversion on an eligible province and exercise Neo-Confucian, urbanization, and Nanban bridge entries; record source-chain and bridge flags before/after to prove no duplicate scheduling.

Run the current-main-old-save phase with the genuine 0.27 CJP save from R4, advance two days, and repeat the center-count, harmonization, protected-target, bridge, save/reload, and natural-conversion checks.
acceptance: Shinto is not harmonized repeatedly.
Ise and every other engine-protected target remain Shinto and never host a Confucian center.
New and genuine old saves both settle at no more than three native centers and permit an eligible natural conversion.
Bridge events fire in CJP without duplicating their source chains or completion flags.

scenarios.title: WAK long-term pressure loop
scenarios.fixture: new WAK disposable campaign plus observer branch
steps: Exercise all three investments, 50 and 85 pressure thresholds, dividend and crisis events, and both exits.

Save/reload mid-cycle, leave the route, record the first-day state, and continue until the one-day-MTTH hidden cleanup actually fires; record its date and fail the branch if it has not fired within 30 days. Then return and naturally pass the 1825-day cooldown to prove a finite investment can be selected again without permanent stacking.

After starting a cycle through the production decision, run an AI observer sample through at least one complete 3651-day charter generation without debug-forcing outcomes; record dates, AI country, every investment, threshold, dividend, crisis, exit, or legal restart that actually occurs, then record the final flag/variable/modifier counts and the start date of any live replacement charter. Random milestones are observations rather than fixed pass prerequisites.
acceptance: Finite modifiers do not stack permanently and both exits close the cycle.
Route loss clears active state.
Companion jxp_map_compat_wokou_waters scope behaves as intended.

At the original charter's fixed expiry, its generation leaves no orphaned cycle flag, pressure value, or cycle modifier. If AI has legally restarted, any surviving state must be paired with one live replacement charter whose recorded start date is later; the stale expiry must not clear that new generation. Random AI choices are not treated as guaranteed milestones.

After starting a cycle through the production decision, run an AI observer sample through at least one complete 3651-day charter generation without debug-forcing outcomes; record dates, AI country, every choice, threshold, petition, crisis, exit, or legal restart that actually occurs, then record the final flag/variable/modifier counts and the start date of any live replacement charter. Random milestones are observations rather than fixed pass prerequisites.
acceptance: IJP does not overlap Shimabara or another active disaster.
Finite modifiers and cycle flags close on either exit or route loss.
The Shinto religion gate, both estate-presence gates, both estate-loyalty gates, Terauchi/community gate, geography gate, and disaster gates each reject an otherwise identical negative fixture.
The two named route missions schedule jxp_ikko.2/.8 once, while the two named final missions and their persistent results survive reload.
